method.question: does one strong 1v1/core-vs-core counter get washed out by current aggregation?
method.train_data: production pub phase SQLite dictionaries; read-only; pro maps excluded by builder contract

labels.early: is_early_match dominator (short maps use winner, long maps first threshold dominator)

method.current_prod: actual get_diff + phase position weights + coverage gate + integer rounding + early Alchemist directional scale
method.paired_pair_edge: for R_i vs D_j: (R lookup WR - mirrored D lookup WR)/2; one physical matchup counted once
method.strongest: paired matchup with largest absolute one-sided edge; x2 only for current-index scale
method.top2: uniform mean of two largest-absolute paired edges; x2 current-index scale
method.role_weighted_mean: production reducer with late role weights 2.4/2.2/1.4/1.2/0.6
method.core_pair_weighted_mean: production reducer with explicit core-vs-core pair weights
method.softmax_tau4: signed mean weighted by exp((abs(edge_pp)-max_abs_pp)/4); x2 current-index scale
method.phase_gating: evaluation uses the same phase eligibility predicates as dictionary labels
method.availability: None/0 excluded from variant accuracy; paired A/B requires both nonzero
method.selection_warning: raw strongest-of-25 has multiple-comparison/maximum-selection bias; treat as candidate, not proof
